criteria.evidence: Jaw/far-wing tangency, foot/tail merger, and hard value bands make the body read as cut paper.
Hard flat shading strips flatten the torso and neck.
Recognizability and local improvements do not meet the intended standard of a convincing creature drawing.

strengths: The head is readable and the wing hand fan is explicit.
weaknesses: Jaw/far-wing tangency, foot/tail merger, and hard value bands make the body read as cut paper.

issues.observation: Jaw/far-wing tangency, foot/tail merger, and hard value bands make the body read as cut paper.
issues.correction: Replace the generic tube construction at the shoulder and hips with a coherent arrangement of skeletal landmarks and muscle masses; study the skull separately.

issues.observation: This is still an elementary construction study rather than a convincing foundation for excellent art.
